training.eligible: R3A same label at 768 and 1536, mass drift <0.05; momentum relative L2 <0.02 at both
training.input: initial Phi,Pi,a,alpha radial profile and requested coordinate time only
training.metrics: per trajectory channel errors normalized by training scales, derived compactness, Ricci; all seeds must beat best baseline to admit forecast; known test family historical, not external blind

echo_probe.trace: central proper time and signed Pi/a at every integration step
echo_probe.method: alternating extrema of signed central derivative; estimate full log-time period as twice log ratio of successive proper-time intervals; require >=5 consecutive resolved alternating peaks, increasing absolute peak amplitude, stable interval ratios and agreement across resolutions; no reference period in estimator
echo_probe.reference_comparison: separate future read-only evaluation after artifact frozen; no target value in probe code

claim_ceiling: historical family-held forecast and candidate echo estimate only; no true horizon, no independent proof of criticality; no production promotion
